intelligence.essence: The cloud leg tapped PERSONAL expecting the Ask Naya room to open, and called it a FAIL when it did not. But PERSONAL never promised to open the room — it promises to yield it: with the room open, tap PERSONAL and the room gives way and closes. The "FAIL" was a misread expectation, not a page failure. Test what the page promises, in the direction it promises it.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a door that only opens outward, sweetheart — you pushed it inward and it didn't move, so you said the door was broken! But the door was never broken, sweetheart — it opens the other way! So before we say something is broken, we check which way it is supposed to open!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — the test tapped PERSONAL hoping the little room would open, dear, and when it didn't, they wrote it down as broken. But PERSONAL was never meant to open the room, love — it is the way home, and when the room is open, PERSONAL gently closes it and takes you home. The page did exactly what it promised, dear — the test just asked it to promise something else.
